answer_1.quote: AutoTOD directly outputs the natural language responses rather than the delexicalized utterances

answer_2.quote: Here we use some language diversity metrics to evaluate the quality of model responses . The metrics include some statistics about words, n-gram and information entropy (number of n-grams, Shannon Entropy (SE), Conditional bigram Entropy (CE), Mean Segmental Type-Token Ratio (MSTTR), Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity (MTLD) and Hypergeometric Distribution Function (HDD)) .

answer_3.quote: the dialogue evaluator employs a pretrained large language model, (GPT-3.5 in our experiments) to extract essential information from the generated dialogues.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to supplement the limitations of automated metrics. We sample 100 dialogues from the test set and ask for 5 graduate students to rate from 4 aspects: language fluency (Fluency), dialogue coherence (Coherence), information accuracy in responses (Informativeness), and overall satisfaction (Satisfaction).
